title: Counit equation of the residue push mate
statement: For any coherent pull comparison family [def-weil-pbc-residue-exchange-comparison-interface], every scheme morphism f and every integral derived complex K, applying residue pullback to its defined push mate followed by the residue counit equals the inverse pull comparison at the integral direct image followed by reduction of the integral counit.

lean.statement:
theorem push_counit {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (K : residueExchangeDerived (integralCoeff ℓ E) X) :
    (residueExchangeUpperStar
        (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} (integralResidue ℓ E)) f).map
        ((c.push f).app K) ≫
      (residueExchangeAdjunction
        (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} (integralResidue ℓ E)) f).counit.app
        ((residueExchangeReduction ℓ E X).obj K) =
    (c.pull f).inv.app ((residueExchangeLowerStar (integralCoeff ℓ E) f).obj K) ≫
      (residueExchangeReduction ℓ E X).map
        ((residueExchangeAdjunction (integralCoeff ℓ E) f).counit.app K)
